label: D2: reached S1 after choosing a2 (rare a2->S1 transition)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (DELAY_2), and 99% of activation mass is at D2 steps where state S1 is shown, and 98% of mass when that S1 came from choosing a2 (a rare transition). It never fires at D1 or GO, and essentially never when S2 is reached. All variables are observed at D2 (state input and last-action input). Dev: P 0.67, R 0.86, F1 0.75, mass recall 0.98. False positives are a2->S1 rare trials where the policy at D2 does not strongly favour a2 (good state S1, or the agent goes on to switch). Adding the model's own D2 policy logit (choice < -4.44, strongly favouring a2) raises F1 to 0.82 with the same mass recall, so the feature is gated by a strong a2 preference. Adding next_action==2 or prev_action==2 helps only slightly (F1 0.78-0.79). A smaller set of high-magnitude activations (about 0.9-1.0 of max) sits on a1->S1 common trials while S2 is the good state, e.g. a one-off a1 inside an a2 streak. These carry little total mass. Repeated rare a2->S1 trials while S2 is good activate at about 0.8-0.9. Isolated rare a2->S1 trials activate around 0.2-0.5.
